paite: Daria Ahasura tapa, Mid-mi chi, Kaldaite gama kumpipa dinga bawl, kum khatna kumin;
english: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans,

paite: a vaihawmkum khatna kumin kei Danialin laibute akipan kumte zah, Jerusalem hihgawpnate pichinna ding, kum sawmsagih, jawlnei Jeremia kianga TOUPA thu hongtung tanchin ka theisiam hi.
english: in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years about which the word of Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. came to Jeremiah the prophet, for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, even seventy years.

paite: Huchiin ka mai OUPA Pathian lamah ka koih kipa, thumna leh thilngetnate, annngawlna leh saiip puan leh, vut toha zong dingin.
english: I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and petitions, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.

paite: Huan TOUPA ka Pathian kiangah ka thuma, thupha ka tawia, Aw TOUPA, Pathian thupi leh mulkimhuai, Nang honita na thupiakte juite tunga thukhun leh chitna vom;
english: I prayed to Yahweh my God, and made confession, and said, Oh, Lord, the great and dreadful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,

paite: Ka khialta ua, hoihlou takin ka gamtang ua, gilou takin ka na hihta ua, ka hel ua, na thusehte akipan leh na vaihawmte akipan ka na kihelheita uh.
english: we have sinned, and have dealt perversely, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even turning aside from your precepts and from your ordinances;

paite: Na mina ka kumpipate uh, ka lalte uleh ka pipute uh leh gama mite tengteng kianga thu gen, na sikha jawlneite leng ka nangaikhe sam kei uhi.
english: neither have we listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

paite: Aw TOUPA, diktatna nanga ahia, himahleh tuni bangin, koua bel mai buaina ahi; Judaa mite leh, Jerusalema tengtengte leh, Israel tengteng, a naia omte, gamlaa omte, amaute na delh khiakna lama gamte tengtengah, na tunga tatleknaa a tatlekna jiak un.
english: Lord, righteousness belongs to you, but to us confusion of face, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, who are near, and who are far off, through all the countries where you have driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against you.

paite: AW TOUPA, koua mai buaina ahia, ka kumpipa te uha, ka lalte uha, ka pipute uha, na tunga ka khelh jiak un.
english: Lord, to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.

paite: Chitnate leh ngaihdamte TOUPA ka Pathian uha ahi; amah tungah lah ka helta ngal ua;
english: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgiveness; for we have rebelled against him;

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw, a dantea om dingin, ka namangta kei ua, a sikha jawlneite zanga ka ma ua honna koihsak.
english: neither have we obeyed the voice of Yahweh our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

paite: A hi, Israel tengtengin na dan a tatleksan ua, a hilou lamah a pial ua, na aw a man louhna ding un; huaijiakin hamsia ka tungah sun buakin a oma, Mosi Pathian sikha dan sunga gelha om kichiamna; nang tungah lah ka khialta ngal ua.
english: Yes, all Israel have transgressed your law, turning aside, that they should not obey your voice: therefore the curse and the oath written in the law of Moses the servant of God has been poured out on us; for we have sinned against him.

paite: Huan koute demna leh, ka tung ua vaihawm vaihawmmite demnaa thute, ka tung ua hoihloup thupi takin a hihkip khinta hi; Jerusalem tunga kihih bang van pumpi nuaiah lah a kihih ngal kei a.
english: He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us, and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great evil; for under the whole sky, such has not been done as has been done to Jerusalem.

paite: Mosi dan sunga gelh a hih bangin, hiai hoihlou tengteng ka tunguah a hongtung hi; huchiin leng TOUPA ka Pathian uh deihsakna, ka ngen nai kei lai ua, huchia ka thulumlouhnate uh kiheisama, na thutaka theihkhentheihna kaneih theihna ding un.
english: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil has come on us: yet have we not entreated the favor of Yahweh our God, that we should turn from our iniquities, and have discernment in your truth.

paite: Huaijiakin TOUPAN thilhoihlou a veng gigea, Ka tunguah a hon tungsakta hi; TOUPA ka Pathian uh lah a hih a thilhihte tengteng ah a diktat gige ngala, kou lah a aw ka namangta kei uhi.
english: Therefore has Yahweh watched over the evil, and brought it on us; for Yahweh our God is righteous in all his works which he does, and we have not obeyed his voice.

paite: Huan tuin, Aw Toupa ka Pathian uh, khut hattaka na mite Aigupta gama kipana pikhepa leh, tuni banga, min thanna kimuhpa, ka khialta ua, gilou takin ka na hihta uhi.
english: Now, Lord our God, who has brought your people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have gotten yourself renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.

paite: Aw TOUPA, ka honngen hi, na diktatna tengteng bangin, na thangpaihna na hehna, na khopi Jerusalem, namual siangthou akipan kihei mang sakin; ka khelhnate uh jiak leh, ka pipute uh thulimlouhna jiakin, Jerusalem leh na mite lah ka kum ka vel ua omte tengteng adingin zumhuai a honghita nal ua.
english: Lord, according to all your righteousness, let your anger and please let your wrath be turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain; because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people have become a reproach to all who are around us.

paite: Huaijiakin tuin, Aw ka Pathian uh, na sikha thumna leh a thilngetna ngaikhia inla, TOUPA jiakin, a segawpsa na munsiangthoupen tungah na mel vak sakin.
english: Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant, and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on your sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.

paite: Aw ka Pathian, na bil hondoh inla, ja in; na mite hak inla, ka siatgawpnate uh enin, khopi na min sap sek; ka diktatna jiak un na maa ka thilngetnate uh lah ka hingal kei ua, na chitna thupite jiak ahi jaw.
english: My God, turn your ear, and hear; open your eyes, and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name: for we do not present our petitions before you for our righteousness, but for your great mercies’ sake.

paite: Aw Toupa, ja in, AW TOUPA ngaidam in, Aw Toupa, ngaikhia inla hih in; hal ken; nangmah jiak mahmahin, Aw ka Pathian, na khopi leh na mite nang mina sap ahi ngal ua.
english: Lord, hear; Lord, forgive; Lord, listen and do; don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.

paite: Huchia thu ka gena, ka thuma, ka khelhna leh ka mi Israel khelhna thupha ka tawia, TOUPA ka Pathian maa ka Pathian mual siangthou adinga thilngetna ka piak laiin;
english: While I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before Yahweh my God for the holy mountain of my God;

paite: A hi, thumnaa thu ka gen laiin, Pasal Gabriel, a chila mengmuhnaa ka muh pa, kintaka leng dia bawla omin, nitaklam thillat hunding khawngin a hongkhoiha.
english: yes, while I was speaking in prayer, the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening offering.

paite: Huan a hon thuhilha, a honhoupiha, Aw Danial, theihsiamnaa siam mahmaha honbawl dingin tuin ka hong pai khia hi, a chi a.
english: He instructed me, and talked with me, and said, Daniel, I am now come forth to give you wisdom and understanding.

paite: Na thilngetna kipat chilin thupiak a paikhia a, nang hilh dinga hongpai ka hi; nakpi taka it lah na hi ngala; huaijiakin thu tuh ngaihtuah inla, mengmuh theisiam in.
english: At the beginning of your petitions the commandment went forth, and I have come to tell you; for you are greatly beloved: therefore consider the matter, and understand the vision.

paite: Na mite leh na khopi siangthou tungah nipikal sawmsagih thupiak ahi; tatlekna hih zou ding leh, khelhna tawpna bawl ding leh, thulimlouhna adia kilepna bawl ding leh, khantawn diktatna honla lut ding leh, mengmuh leh genkhawlna khak khum bikbek ding leh mun siangthoupen sathau nilh dingin.
english: Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most holy.

paite: Huaijiakin thei inla theikak in, Jerusalem tung ding nawn ding leh lam dia thupiak a paikhiak a kipan sathau nilha ompa, lal, tanin, nipikal sagih ahi ding; huan nipikal sawmgukleh nih sung a kilam nawn ding, hun haksa mahmahtea kongzing leh bukna guam toh.
english: Know therefore and discern, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem to the Anointed One, “Anointed One” can also be translated “Messiah” (same as “Christ”). the prince, shall be seven weeks, and sixty-two weeks: it shall be built again, with street and moat, even in troubled times.

paite: Huan nipikal sawmguk leh nih khit chiangin sathau nilha ompa sat khiakin a om dinga, bangmah a neikei ding hi; huchiin a hongomding lal miten khopi leh munsiangthoupen a hihse ding ua; huan amah tawpna tuikhang toh ahi ding, a tawpna mahmah ah kidouna a om dinga, siatgawpnate ngaihtuahsa a hita hi.Huchiin nipikal khat adingin tampi toh thukhun khauh tak a bawl dinga; huan nipikal kimkhat adingin kithoihna leh thillat a khawl sakding; kihuaite kha tungah hihgawpa omsak mi a hongpai dinga; huan a tawppha nangawn tan hialin, ngaihtuahsaa om thangpaihna hihgawppa tungah sun buak in a om ding hi.
english: After the sixty-two weeks the Anointed One “Anointed One” can also be translated “Messiah” (same as “Christ”). shall be cut off, and shall have nothing: and the people of the prince who shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and its end shall be with a flood, and even to the end shall be war; desolations are determined.

paite: Huchiin nipikal khat adingin tampi toh thukhun khauh tak a bawl dinga; huan nipikal kimkhat adingin kithoihna leh thillat a khawl sakding; kihuaite kha tungah hihgawpa omsak mi a hongpai dinga; huan a tawppha nangawn tan hialin, ngaihtuahsaa om thangpaihna hihgawppa tungah sun buak in a om ding hi.
english: He shall make a firm covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the offering to cease; and on the wing of abominations shall come one who makes desolate; and even to the full end, and that determined, shall wrath be poured out on the desolate.
